basic_info.description: Residence #636 is a stylish junior one-bedroom offering a smart, open layout and coveted south-facing exposure that fills the home with beautiful natural light. The sleek kitchen features Studio Becker custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and Cambria stone countertops, ideal for modern urban living. The open-concept living and dining area extends to a private balcony, perfect for enjoying fresh air and sunshine. A glass partition defines the bedroom alcove, which includes a closet and space for a desk.     Located directly across from the new 4th & Brannan Muni station, this home offers unbeatable transit access and is just steps from Whole Foods, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and some of the city's best restaurants and bars.    Residents at The Palms enjoy full-service amenities including a 24-hour concierge and security, fitness center, business and conference rooms, a resident lounge, and a 20-seat private theater.
